theory_query: Build theories of how biaxial strain (coherent growth on Si or Ge substrates) changes the in-plane and cross-plane lattice thermal conductivity of Si1-xGex films and of strained silicon and germanium, through changes in phonon group velocities, anharmonicity and scattering.
mission_statement:
The theories will be used to answer the following questions before the corresponding simulation results are seen. Address the mechanisms they depend on:


H7. A Si0.5Ge0.5 film is grown coherently on Si(001) (biaxial in-plane
compression of about 2 %) and kappa is computed by Tersoff MD in-plane and
across the film, compared with relaxed bulk Si0.5Ge0.5.
Category for the cross-plane change at 300 K: "increase", "decrease",
"no change within 5 %". Value: cross-plane change at 300 K in percent.
State in "theory" what happens in-plane.
